title: Count the findings a reviewer repeats from one review round to the next, per change
why: Goal v4 row 3 (f) of triage 11, set by the owner 12:11 CST Nov 18: blog practice f, count findings repeated across review rounds. Owner ruling 19:45 CST Nov 17 (relayed by the consultant): land the verification article's findings. No step existed for (f) until now.
source: triage 11 goal v4 row 3 (f); owner 19:45 CST Nov 17 via the consultant
note: Start with a prior-work search: step review-layer-recall-eval (practice a) may already count what each round catches; extend its home, build no second one (rule building-one-home-per-capability). Mistake it stops: a round that re-reports a finding the last round raised and the fix did not close. Harm: wasted rounds, and the three-round cap spent on the same finding. Read first: the review records posted as PR comments (record form in decision pr-review-record). Measure with a count over merged PRs before any rule changes; say unmeasured until then. A change to a review round needs the owner's grant. Ends as a landed check or rule, or an owner pick on a named question.
